The coziest way to buckle up might be the least safe one.

Puffy coats are mostly air. In a crash, that padding flattens and can leave the car seat straps too loose.

The fix is free: buckle your kid in snug in thin layers, then tuck a blanket or put their coat on backwards over the straps. Hats and mittens add warmth without getting in the way.

Not sure about a jacket? Tighten the straps over it, take it off without loosening, and buckle back in. If you can pinch extra strap, it's too bulky.
